about: FIELD REGISTER STEP A + (b) (fix/pine-host-field-register-untraced, on #2014): a field register is untraced unless every read of it follows an unconditional write of it in the same bar (`pineObjects.js::dominatedFields`), so the 26-label shape is withheld by name and a field written then used in one bar (G's red boxes) keeps its register. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: every field register is registered again, dominated or not (a field Step B does not serve becomes a cleared local)
every read counts as dominated (the 26-label shape keeps its cleared register)
no read counts as dominated (a field written then used in one bar loses its register)
mutants.from: for (const f of fields) if (!undominated.has(f)) out.add(f)
mutants.to: for (const f of fields) if (false) out.add(f)
